sections.title: Resonance Skill: Dream Blend

lines: Casting this skill sends Lily into Slumberland and grants Cradle Lullaby to Resonators in the team.
Slumber

Lasts for 50s. When Lily is in Slumberland, she heals the nearby active Resonator every 3s. During Slumberland, use directional input to command Dreambind to deal Spectro DMG to nearby targets. Dreambind pulls in targets within a certain range every 5s, and stops attacking 10s after movement stops. Press Resonance Liberation again during Slumberland to end it early.
When Lily is in Slumberland, when a Resonator in the team casts Intro Skill, targets within a certain range are pulled in.

Switching to another Resonator during Slumberland keeps Lily on the field, and she takes no DMG while in Slumberland. Lily leaves the field when Slumberland ends, or earlier if she gets too far from the active Resonator.
Cradle Lullaby
Lasts for 25s. While this effect is active, each Intro Skill cast by a Resonator in the team grants 1 stack of Dream Aroma. This effect is removed when Lily is the incoming Resonator.
Dream Aroma
Each stack increases the ATK of all Resonators in the team by 7%, stacking up to 4 times. This effect is removed when Lily is the incoming Resonator or when Cradle Lullaby ends.

lines: All skills used by Sunbringer deal Sharp DMG, with DEF used as the skill DMG Multiplier. Some Sharp DMG builds up Gash. When Gash buildup is full, the enemy enters [Gash]. [Gash] stacks up to 3 times. When certain skills' heavy attacks from Sunbringer hit an enemy in the [Gash] state, 1 stack of [Gash] is consumed to deal AoE DMG once;

When a critical hit is triggered, Sharp DMG does not benefit from CRIT DMG Bonus and uses Laceration DMG Bonus instead. If CRIT Rate exceeds 100% and a critical hit has been triggered, an additional Laceration check is made based on the excess CRIT Rate. If Laceration is triggered, Laceration DMG Bonus is applied one additional time. For every 1% of initial CRIT DMG Sunbringer has, initial CRIT Rate increases by 0.35%;
Sunbringer recovers 60 Sharpness upon entering the battlefield. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s;

When Sunbringer enters combat, Sunbringer gains the [Midnight Sun] effect, increasing CRIT Rate by 40% and ignoring 20% of the target's DEF when dealing DMG. [Midnight Sun] lasts 15s, and its duration does not decrease while Eldreda and Lindverne are off field. Sunbringer regains the [Midnight Sun] effect upon using any [EX Special Attack] or [Basic Attack: Bannerbearer - Converging Edge];
After Dracaene activates [Defensive Assist], the [Assist Follow-Up] launched by Eldreda and Lindverne gains 15% increased Gash Buildup Rate and deals 20% increased DMG;

When any squad Agent triggers [Maim], Sunbringer gains 40 [Willpower] for each stack of [Gash] removed, up to a maximum of 160 [Willpower]. When Sunbringer has at least 120 [Willpower], 120 [Willpower] can be consumed to activate [Basic Attack: Bannerbearer - Converging Edge];

When a teammate triggers [Maim], if Sunbringer has enough [Willpower], [Quick Assist] is triggered. When Sunbringer switches on field via [Quick Assist], 120 [Willpower] is consumed to immediately activate [Basic Attack: Bannerbearer - Converging Edge]. This effect can trigger once every 3s;

When Sunbringer's [Basic Attack: Bannerbearer - Converging Edge], [EX Special Attack: Night Blaze - End of the Long Dark], [EX Special Attack: Kindled Lamp - Torch of Eternal Day], [Ultimate: "Onward, Together"], or [Ultimate: "By This Wish, All Things Remade"] hits an enemy and deals DMG, the target accumulates [Ember Scar] equal to 75% of the actual DMG dealt by the skill. When the Finishing Move of Eldreda's [EX Special Attack: Kindled Lamp - Torch of Eternal Day] or [Ultimate: "By This Wish, All Things Remade"] hits an enemy, all [Ember Scar] is cleared, directly deducting an equal amount of HP.
When an attack hits a normal enemy, if the [Ember Scar] it holds is greater than or equal to its current HP, all of its [Ember Scar] is immediately cleared and the enemy is defeated.

sections.title: Ultimate: Robin Ultimate

lines: When Robin uses certain skills, she grants all squad members a [Robin Shield] equal to a set percentage of her initial Max HP, lasting 15s. When a character gains [Robin Shield] again, the shield value stacks and its duration is extended, up to a maximum of 60s. The shield value cannot exceed 8% of Robin's initial Max HP.
Each time a squad member gains [Robin Shield], their DMG is increased by 25% for 15s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration.

Using [Special Attack: Step Up] triggers a Quick Assist. After switching out, Robin enters the [Off-Field Guard] state for 60s. While in [Off-Field Guard], Robin gains [Entry Points] when her Aftershock is triggered, up to a maximum of 120 points.

When Robin has 100 or more [Entry Points], she can be manually switched in via her [Entry Skill]. Switching in automatically consumes 100 [Entry Points] to activate the [Entry Skill] and ends the [Off-Field Guard] state.
When Robin uses her [Entry Skill], she gains 1 [Buff Enhance Point], up to a maximum of 1.
Upon entering the [Off-Field Guard] state, if Robin has a [Buff Enhance Point], she consumes 1 [Buff Enhance Point] to further increase the DEF bonus provided by [Off-Field Guard] and its cap by 25%.
Each time a squad member triggers Maim, Robin recovers 15 Energy.
